items.title: What's Moving Markets Today?
items.summary: Major indexes edged lower as the yield on the 10-year Treasury note pushed past 5%. Markets have had a lot to digest this week: a quarter-point interest-rate hike, fluctuating fuel prices and big tech's P(doom)--aka the probability that AI results in a existentially catastrophic outcome, according to the Silicon Valley ecosystem.
